reasoning.step1:
Document classification:
- Contains explicit invoice indicators ("Factura", "CFDI", "Total", "I.V.A.", "Total Factura").
- No exclusion headers ("Zahlungserinnerung", "Mahnung", "Servicebericht") dominating.
-> Treat as invoice.

Candidate invoice-level fields found:
- Grand total: "Total Factura (GXT + CFDI) : 7,498.78" (page 1). Also "Saldo CFDI : 7,498.78" — consistent. Select 7,498.78 as GrandTotal.Amount.
- Invoice date: "Fecha Emisión : 15/12/2022 10:27:01" (page 1). Use date string "15/12/2022".
- Sender VAT/Tax ID: Emisor RFC : "LAJ160818355" (page 1). Use as Sender.VatId.

VAT group extraction:
- VAT rate appears as "I.V.A. 16 %", and multiple line items show Tasa 0.160000 (16%). Use Vat.Rate = 16 (without %).
- Net amount for VAT group: The invoice shows "Total Ingresos : 1,020.00" and "I.V.A. 16 % : 163.20" with "Total Servicios CFDI : 1,183.20" (page 1). The taxable net base for that VAT group is 1,020.00. So Net.Amount = 1020.00 and Vat.Amount = 163.20.

Verify alternatives:
- Could net be entire invoice subtotal (7,498.78) — but VAT amount shown (163.20) corresponds only to the service group (1,020.00 net). Other charges (6,315.58) are listed as "Gastos por Cuenta de Terceros" likely non-taxable or separate. Therefore choose the VAT group tied to 16% with net 1,020.00 and VAT 163.20.

Missing/No-inference checks:
- All chosen values explicitly present in text; no guessing used.
- Keep decimal precision as in source.

Planned mapping to schema:
- GrandTotal.Amount: 7,498.78 (number)
- Invoice.Date: "15/12/2022" (string)
- Sender.VatId: "LAJ160818355" (string)
- Vat.Rate: 16 (number)
- Net.Amount: 1020.00 (number)
- Vat.Amount: 163.20 (number)
